newsitem.title: USA: O.J. Simpson juror dismissed for alcohol misconduct.
newsitem.headline: O.J. Simpson juror dismissed for alcohol misconduct.

text.p: Jury selection in the O.J. Simpson civil trial was thrown into disarray Friday when a juror was dismissed from the panel less than 24 hours after it was sworn in.

Judge Hiroshi Fujisaki dismissed juror number eight, a black man in his 40s, for "alcohol misconduct." He said lawyers would be allowed to use their six remaining challenges on the 11 panelists remaining on the jury.
